reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault in the integrated heat pump, gave a properly isolated (unplugged, water off) resistance test with sensible expected readings, confirmed the open-circuit result as a failed heat pump, and gave honest repair-vs-replace guidance for a 9-year-old machine including ordering by E-Nr/FD. Conversation 2 asked three rounds of low-value questions, ignored the repeated cost question, never offered the heater test or explained the E:09 meaning, and ended by declining to identify the part despite the model being known, pushing straight to an engineer. One minor flaw in Conversation 1 (suggesting a 9-year-old machine might still be under warranty) is outweighed by its far superior diagnosis and escalation advice.
